INT. STUDIO A - NIGHT

The crew resets for the last take.
Call sheet 2026-09-10. Scenes 12-18. Units: Studio A, Backlot. Cast: MAYA, DANIEL. Crew call 07:00, first shot 08:30. Weather: rain expected after 18:00.
Backlot: night exteriors only after 20:00 due to neighbour agreement. Rain machine requires two hours of prep and a standby plumber. Picture vehicles park on the north side.
Delivery spec for post partners: ProRes 422 HQ, 1920x1080, 24 fps, stereo mix at -23 LUFS. Turnaround for approved dailies is 24 hours.
The film shoots on a practical backlot with a full-scale street set. Published behind-the-scenes material covers the rain sequence and the picture vehicles. Press contact: press@example.com.
